create_data_loader: create a data loader by calling CreateDataLoader with an options object
create_dataset: create a dataset by calling CreateDataset with an options object for audio visual model
build_custom_data_loader: build a CustomDatasetDataLoader instance that wraps a torch DataLoader for train or val mode
test_data_loader_iteration: test iterating over the data loader to yield batches of data
summarize_data_loader_length: summarize the data loader length by calling __len__ on the CustomDatasetDataLoader
